items.title: Quanta (NYSE:PWR) Reports Upbeat Q2 CY2026, Stock Jumps 13.5%
items.summary: Infrastructure solutions provider Quanta (NYSE:PWR) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 41.1% year on year to $9.56 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $39.5 billion at the midpoint came in 12.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.24 per share was 28.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Quanta Services Surges On Blowout Earnings For AI Power Infrastructure Giant
items.summary: Quanta Services, the nation's largest electrical infrastructure construction company, blew away second-quarter earnings forecasts and massively raised its full-year outlook amid the artificial intelligence buildout boom.  Quanta said its improved visibility, record backlog and four recently completed acquisitions played into the big increase in its 2026 outlook.  "We believe these results and our long-term track record are a clear differentiator of Quanta's ability to compound profitable growth as our customers accelerate investment in the electric grid, power generation and mission-critical infrastructure that underpin the economy," CEO Duke Austin said in the earnings statement.
